messages.subject: Beta JupyterHub for UCD
parts:
D-RUG,

Some of you may be interested in checking out our recently launched JupyterHub for UCD and LibreTexts users:

jupyter.libretexts.org

We are in beta for this academic year and are primarly serving educational needs but, in the future, we will likely support research needs of varying compute capacities. We do have RStudio server setup too (after you are logged in and spawned, change the "/lab?" in the url to "/rstudio").

If you'd like to try it out you can request an account from jupyt...@ucdavis.edu.
